milestones.title: Your organization's authorizing official accepts the risk, or a key access server is planned

remediation: Your organization runs no key access server for partners, so an export wrapped to a partner's key is final: nothing can withdraw access after release. Your organization's authorizing official accepts that risk, or a key access server at your site is planned. Source: .planning/phases/45.2-nato-and-five-eyes-exchange-part-2-ztdf-and-the-nato-texts/45.2-CONTEXT.md D-11.
title: An export cannot be revoked once it is wrapped to a partner key
